comments.author: Katarzyna Drąg
comments.comment: The hidden work is usually not the model call, it is the contract around it: context selection, tool permissions, retry logic, latency budgets, evals, and fallbacks. A useful test is this: if the answer is bad, can your product tell whether retrieval, routing, tool use, or policy was the failing layer?

comments.author: David Marques
comments.comment:
The useful test is whether the harness makes failure states inspectable, not whether the agent loop looks clever.

Approval gates, resumability, tool traces, and state snapshots decide whether an agent is debuggable after hour 3. Curious how you compare harnesses on recovery from a bad tool call.
